releases.body:
### Changed
- The footer meter shows the percentage of credits **used** instead of the percentage left, matching the
  *Usage* column of `/zai-limits`: `z.ai | 3h 33m : 45% | 2d : 20%`. The green/yellow/red color still follows
  the remaining 5h credits.
- A 5-hour window that has not started (nothing used) is left out of the meter (`z.ai | 2d : 20%`) instead of
  showing `5h : 100%`, and the meter reads `z.ai | full` when nothing is used in either window.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ManeFunction/opencode-zai-limits/compare/v0.9.1...v1.0.0

Technical release to validate an nmp trusted publisher.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ManeFunction/opencode-zai-limits/compare/v0.9.0...v0.9.1

Initial release.

Derived from [guyinwonder168/opencode-glm-quota](https://github.com/guyinwonder168/opencode-glm-quota) (as of [PR #52](https://github.com/guyinwonder168/opencode-glm-quota/pull/52) by @itelyatnikov80, commit `dafcf639`),
security-reviewed and then reworked into its own zero-dependency project.
Not a fork and not intended to be merged back.

**THE BIGGEST IMPROVEMENT FOR THE END USER:** Neither the footer meter nor `/zai-limits` spends credits or tokens:
both only make plain monitoring GETs, with no agent and no model call.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ManeFunction/opencode-zai-limits/commits/v0.9.0

Features:

* improved /zai-limits TUI popup structure
* added opencode bun:sqlite support to remove external sqlite dependency
* Renamed glm-limits to zai-limits
* /glm-limits do not launch subagent anymore
* initial rework

Fixes:

* rename glm leftovers
* share MCP tool labels and format MCP usage numbers
* fall back to per-model tokens when 24h totals read zero
* drop the 40M token sentinel and its fallback loop
* surface API errors instead of an empty report
* decode response body as a UTF-8 stream

Refactor:

* move the report renderer into src/report/
* one duration helper for the report and the meter
* parse the quota response into one typed model
